observations: MERFISH cells that passed QC, mapped to the whole mouse brain taxonomy and registered to the CCF; counts are decoded transcripts per cell

coordinates.raw: x, y are the section coordinates from cell_metadata, also in micrometres; z_mm is the section position

region_assignment: CCF parcellation of each cell's registered position; unassigned = outside the parcellation

ranks.direction: ascending: larger rank means higher expression
ranks.zeros: all unstored genes have rank zero_rank2 / 2; stored ranks are absolute
ranks.universe: every MERFISH panel gene except the Blank control barcodes

pseudobulk.description: per section and annotation level: summed panel-gene counts per (label, gene), <level>_counts rows follow <level>_index into labels[level]; <level>_cells counts cells
